name: Arcturus CorpSec Hazmat Liaison Suit
description: Issued to Arcturus personnel assigned to cordon and containment operations in chemically or biologically compromised zones, the Hazmat Liaison Suit bridges the gap between tactical response and environmental protection. The outer shell is a matte-grey aramid-polysilicate weave rated for low-level chemical splash, with a sealed inner membrane that can be pressurized for thirty minutes of clean air via the integrated rebreather collar. Shoulder panels carry Arcturus branding in subdued phosphor-reactive grey, visible only under UV. Chrome ports at the wrists, upper spine, and left forearm allow arm-mounted tactical augments to interface through the sealed material without compromising the suit's integrity.
cultural_context: Wearing an Arcturus Hazmat Liaison Suit in the Gray Zone marks you as either corporate muscle or someone who looted one from a dead operative. Either way, people give you space. In Tier 2 and 3 districts, seeing these suits means something bad is being quietly contained nearby.
story_hooks: A decommissioned suit turns up at a the Gray Zone market with the internal telemetry logs still intact — the last six hours of an operative's life are recorded inside.
A player needs to pass a Tier 3 corporate checkpoint and manages to acquire one of these suits, but the biometric collar won't seal without a valid Arcturus employee ID.
The suits are being recalled without explanation. Workers who wore them for extended periods are reporting neurological symptoms Lazarus clinics can't identify.
related_entities: Axiom Systems Perimeter Denial System PDS-4 'Cordon'
Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Hematic Sentinel Array — 'The Warden'

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, militaristic full-body suit with a utilitarian silhouette that projects controlled authority. The matte-grey colorway absorbs light rather than reflects it, creating a presence of deliberate anonymity. Shoulder panels sit slightly elevated and defined. The overall impression is of someone sealed and isolated, yet ready for immediate action.
physical_description.fit: Precision-tailored compression fit through the torso and limbs, allowing full tactical mobility without excess fabric. The suit hugs the body closely, emphasizing augmentation ports and professional posture. Slightly loose at the wrists and ankles for equipment attachment and seal compatibility.
physical_description.primary_material: Aramid-polysilicate weave—a high-tech ballistic composite with chemical-resistant coating. The outer shell is durable and self-healing under minor damage. Matte finish suppresses reflectivity.
physical_description.texture: Smooth but slightly textured surface with a faint grid pattern from the weave structure. The rebreather collar features fine ribbed segments for seal integrity. Wrist and ankle cuffs have a softer, more flexible texture for comfort under extended wear.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte industrial grey throughout, with subdued phosphor-reactive grey Arcturus logos on shoulder panels (invisible under normal light, bright silver-green under UV). Chrome accent ports gleam at wrists, spine, and left forearm.
physical_description.closures: Full-length magnetic-snap closure running down the front center, reinforced with friction-fit thermal seals at the neck, wrists, and ankles. The rebreather collar locks via quarter-turn bayonet mechanism.
distinctive_features: Integrated pressurized rebreather collar with 30-minute clean air capacity
Chrome-lined augmentation interface ports at both wrists, upper spine, and left forearm
Phosphor-reactive Arcturus branding visible only under UV light
Sealed inner membrane with micro-ventilation channels
Reinforced shoulder panels with built-in cable routing for external tools
Subtle hazard striping on inner collar (visible only when sealed)
Utility loops along hip and thigh areas for cordless equipment
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 corporate issue—expensive enough to signal institutional backing, austere enough to suggest serious operational purpose rather than vanity
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this suit announces corporate authority, hazmat containment clearance, or theft of same. In the Gray Zone and lower districts, it triggers immediate social distance and suspicion. Street runners recognize it as either a corpo asset or a very dangerous scavenger.
physical_description.condition_typical: When properly maintained: pristine, with chrome ports polished and seals intact. When field-worn: minor scuffs and micro-tears patched with bio-adhesive, collar seals showing salt deposits, phosphor logos beginning to fade from UV exposure
